resume_text: Final year B.Tech student in Computer Science at ABC University with strong interest in full stack development. Built ShopEasy, an e-commerce platform using React, Node and MongoDB with payment integration and an admin dashboard. Also built a Weather Dashboard using Python and Flask that shows live forecasts for multiple cities. Won first prize at CodeFest 2025 hackathon and completed the AWS Cloud Practitioner certification. Interned at TechNova as a backend developer working on REST APIs and database optimisation.
